about.title: Locally owned in Hood River
paragraphs: Highline Tree Co. is a small, local crew taking care of trees for homes and properties across the Columbia Gorge.
Big removals near houses, careful pruning and stump grinding: we plan every job before the first cut, protect your yard while we work, and haul everything away when we're done.
You get a clear written quote, a crew that shows up when we say, and a yard that looks better than when we arrived.

estimate.title: Tell us about your trees.
estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll get back to you with a free, written quote.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon about your free quote.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Dead, leaning or unwanted trees taken down safely, even right next to the house.
services.intro: When a tree has to come down, we take it down in sections, control every piece and protect your home, driveway and landscaping along the way.
includes: Trees close to homes, fences and power lines
Wood hauled away or cut to firewood length
photos: Crew cutting up a removed tree

services.name: Pruning & Trimming
services.blurb: Healthier, safer trees with better shape, light and views.
services.intro: Good pruning keeps trees healthy and strong, lets light into your yard and clears branches away from roofs and power lines.
includes: Clearance from roofs, driveways and lines

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Stumps ground below grade so you get your yard back.
services.intro: We grind stumps below the surface so you can plant, seed or build right over the spot.
includes: Chips raked out or left for mulch

services.name: Hazard Tree Assessment
services.blurb: Not sure a tree is safe? We'll take a look and tell you straight.
services.intro: Rot, cracks and lean aren't always easy to spot. We check the trees near your home and give you honest options, from pruning to removal.
includes: Rot, cracks, lean and root problems
photos: Old oak with a hollow trunk

services.name: Brush Chipping & Cleanup
services.blurb: Branches, brush and storm debris chipped and hauled away.
services.intro: After a storm or a big yard project, we chip the brush on site and leave the yard clean.
includes: Firewood cut and stacked on request
Chips hauled away or left for mulch
photos: Logs being cut after a removal

services.name: Lot & View Clearing
services.blurb: Overgrown lots and blocked views opened back up.
services.intro: From a building lot to an overgrown back corner, we clear trees and brush so you can use the space again.
includes: Clearing for building lots and driveways
photos: Arborist with a chainsaw among pine trees
